note: The Data2Map layer registry. Datasets carry provenance; layers are what the panel renders. Seeded with `npm run data2map:seed`, read by lib/data2map.ts, and copied from here into PostGIS - the file is the source of truth.

datasets.name: Land price — demo grid
datasets.attribution: Simulated land-price grid generated by Kami3D.
datasets.note: Simulated prices on a hex grid. Vietnam publishes land price tables as legal documents, not as machine-readable polygons - see docs/DATA2MAP.md.

datasets.name: Zoning — demo parcels
datasets.attribution: Simulated zoning parcels generated by Kami3D.
datasets.note: Simulated land-use parcels. Real zoning is published as decisions and drawings, not as open GeoJSON.

datasets.name: Amenities (OpenStreetMap)
datasets.note: Schools, hospitals, markets and parks as mapped in OpenStreetMap. Fetched per view rather than stored, per the ODbL guidance on derived databases.

datasets.name: Food & drink (OpenStreetMap)
datasets.note: Cafes, bubble-tea shops, restaurants and bakeries as mapped in OpenStreetMap. Fetched per view rather than stored, per the ODbL guidance on derived databases - this is the real competitor count behind the site score.

datasets.name: Footfall — simulated hourly index
datasets.attribution: Simulated footfall index generated by Kami3D (CC0).
datasets.note: No open dataset of hourly footfall exists for Vietnam, so this index is simulated: a curve over the real population counts, shaped by an hourly profile per type of business. Every hex says so.

datasets.name: Population (WorldPop 2020)
datasets.attribution: WorldPop 2020, 100 m gridded population (CC BY 4.0), summed per hex through the WorldPop statistics API.
datasets.note: Real counts. WorldPop's 100 m grid summed per hex through their statistics service, fetched by npm run trends:fetch and committed - no raster and no tile pipeline in this repository.

datasets.name: Fleet traces — simulated GPS
datasets.attribution: Simulated vehicle traces generated by Kami3D.
datasets.note: Fleet telemetry is private by nature; these are generated traces with the same shape as real ones.

datasets.name: Road network (OpenStreetMap)
datasets.note: The road graph a route is drawn on. Fetched per view rather than stored.

datasets.name: Story points — curated
datasets.attribution: Kami3D story entries, citing the linked sources.
datasets.note: Eight curated entries with real coordinates and a story each. Photographs come from Wikimedia Commons and are credited per entry in data/data2map-stories.json.

datasets.name: Vegetation index (NDVI)
datasets.note: Needs a tile pipeline the project does not have yet; the licence is settled, the infrastructure is not.

datasets.name: Flood risk — demo bands
datasets.attribution: Simulated seasonal flood bands generated by Kami3D.
datasets.note: Simulated flood extent with a return period per band. Provincial hazard maps are not published as open polygons.

layers.label: Land price
layers.hint: Price per square metre, on a hex grid.

layers.label: Amenities
layers.hint: Schools, hospitals, markets and parks around a plot.

layers.label: Population density
layers.hint: Real population per hex - WorldPop 2020, CC BY 4.0 - coloured as people per km². Does not change with the clock.

layers.label: Hourly footfall
layers.hint: Simulated index by hour and type of business (CC0). It replaces the density colouring while it is on - same hexes, different numbers.

layers.label: Food & drink
layers.hint: Cafes, bubble-tea shops, restaurants and bakeries from OpenStreetMap (ODbL), fetched per view.

layers.label: Fleet traces
layers.hint: Simulated vehicle traces with a playable clock.

layers.label: Road network
layers.hint: The road graph routes are drawn on.

layers.label: Story points
layers.hint: Curated, cited places with a short entry each.

layers.label: Vegetation index
layers.hint: NDVI raster over the growing season.
